## Overview

Research on antimicrobial use, antimicrobial resistance and One Health surveillance, including work with broiler farmers and on bacteria isolated from broiler chicken meat in Mzimba, and on *Escherichia coli* from pigs and cattle slaughtered at abattoirs in Lilongwe.

## Publications

- Chipembo AC, Kalumbi MH, Kamara A, et al., including **Mastala PI**. Phenotypic Antimicrobial Resistance Patterns in *E. coli*, *Salmonella*, and *Enterobacter* Species Isolated from Broiler Chicken Meat in Mzimba, Malawi: Insights from the Multiple Antibiotic Resistance Index. *Antibiotics*. 2026;15(10):1028. [doi:10.3390/antibiotics15101028](https://doi.org/10.3390/antibiotics15101028)
- Nkhoma C, Chikwana N, **Mastala PI**, Kapalamula T. Prevalence of ESBL-associated resistance genes and antimicrobial resistance in *Escherichia coli* from pigs and cattle slaughtered at urban abattoirs in Lilongwe District, Malawi. *Frontiers in Veterinary Science*. 2026;13:1886903. [doi:10.3389/fvets.2026.1886903](https://doi.org/10.3389/fvets.2026.1886903)
- Chipembo AC, Zulu GE, **Mastala PI**, et al. Antimicrobial Use and Resistance: Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices of Broiler Farmers in Mzimba, Malawi. *Antibiotics*. 2026;15(3):239. [doi:10.3390/antibiotics15030239](https://doi.org/10.3390/antibiotics15030239)
